description: This file defines a singleton actor `TranscriptsStore` that manages the storage and retrieval of transcript log entries. It handles reading from and writing to a log file stored in the user's Application Support directory. Additionally, it extends the `String` class with a utility method for appending a line to a file.

classes.name: TranscriptsStore
classes.description: A singleton actor responsible for storing and managing transcript logs, including reading from and writing to a log file located in the user's Application Support directory.

methods.name: init()
methods.description: Initializes the `TranscriptsStore`, creating the directory if needed and loading existing entries from the log file.

methods.name: append(text: String)
methods.description: Appends a new text entry to the transcript log, ensuring the limit is maintained.

methods.name: latest() -> [String]
methods.description: Returns the most recent transcript entries.
